entries.title: Find points by compass direction
entries.objective: Compare labelled grid positions using compass directions.

entries.title: Find the missing bond numbers
entries.objective: Find missing parts of number bonds and use them to make a new whole.

entries.title: Find the other number in the sum
entries.objective: Work out the total on one side, then find the addend that makes both sides equal.

entries.title: How many more or fewer?
entries.objective: Count two pictured sets, decide which is larger, and subtract to find how many more or fewer.

entries.title: Build numbers with digit cards
entries.objective: Choose the tens card first to make the smallest allowed number or to find both the smallest and greatest numbers.

entries.title: Find and combine equal groups
entries.objective: Use the size of one group to find an equal group, then find the combined total.

entries.title: Calculate with the greatest and smallest numbers
entries.objective: Find the greatest and smallest numbers in a set, then add them or find how much greater the largest is than the smallest.

entries.title: Who is next to them in the row?
entries.objective: Use an ordinal position or a named reference to find the neighbour just after or just before it in a row.

entries.title: From a number name to digits
entries.objective: Read a two-digit number name and write the number using digits.

entries.title: Check sentences against pictured groups
entries.objective: Count equal groups and the items in each group, then choose or reject a sentence that represents the total.

entries.title: Add counts from a picture graph
entries.objective: Find two or three named groups in a picture graph and add their counts.

entries.title: Choose affordable purchases
entries.objective: Use price tags to find two items within a budget or to work out the change from one affordable purchase.

entries.title: Count on and back with tens
entries.objective: Use the value of a ten to add whole tens or take ones away from a whole ten.

entries.title: Who came at each time?
entries.objective: Read four clock faces and use before, after and last to match each child to a time.

entries.title: Which happened first?
entries.objective: Read labelled clocks and use the part of the day to find the first event or put all the events in order.

entries.title: How many do they have together?
entries.objective: Use a more or fewer clue to find one child’s quantity, then add both children’s quantities.

entries.title: Compare rows in a picture graph
entries.objective: Compare two named rows, decide whether a named row has the most or fewest objects, and order three labels by their counts.

entries.title: Compare amounts of money
entries.objective: Find how much more or less one amount is, or use the extra amount to find the larger total.

entries.title: Shape hunt
entries.objective: Count one kind of shape in a picture or find the kind that is missing.

entries.title: Count two collections
entries.objective: Record each pictured collection separately and use both counts when sharing is requested.

entries.title: Counters for cups
entries.objective: Count a collection and find how many counters are left after filling a given number of equal groups.

entries.title: Read the groups in a sum
entries.objective: Count the equal addends and use their value to describe or match the groups.

entries.title: Find the number from two clues
entries.objective: Use clues to find the tens and ones digits and write the two-digit numeral.

entries.title: Can we use them all?
entries.objective: Check whether all the objects can be shared equally or packed in full bags. Count any left over.

entries.title: Follow two counting clues
entries.objective: Use one comparison to find a count, then use that count in the next comparison. Add the three counts only when asked for their total.

entries.title: Find the greatest or smallest number
entries.objective: Read four values and identify the one that is greatest or smallest.

entries.title: Compare strings and poles
entries.objective: Find the shortest, longest or tallest item by comparing all the pictured lengths.

entries.title: Find the matching box
entries.objective: Count the objects in each box and choose the box with exactly the number asked for.

entries.title: Compare two lengths or estimate their total
entries.objective: Measure two lengths in centimetres, then find their difference or estimate their total.

entries.title: Measure a string with tiles
entries.objective: Estimate the length of a string to the nearest whole centimetre using both ends of the string.

entries.title: Find the missing tens or ones
entries.objective: Use a total and one known part to find how many tens or ones make up the other part.

entries.title: Put numbers in order
entries.objective: Put four numbers in decreasing order or choose the row that increases at every step.

entries.title: Count from one end
entries.objective: Count from the starting end to find a card or its place.

entries.title: Find the other boat maker
entries.objective: Use a picture graph and a more-than clue to find a pair’s total, then identify the child who supplies the missing part.

entries.title: Read a picture and make an equation
entries.objective: Count pictured objects and use their groups or marks to build or choose a matching equation.

entries.title: Compare stamp collections
entries.objective: Use a picture graph to find the difference between two named rows or to identify a row from a difference clue.

entries.title: What is left on the sticker sheet?
entries.objective: Read the rows named in the question and find how many stickers remain after some are peeled off.

entries.title: Find both parts of a number bond
entries.objective: Count two pictured groups or choose two numbers that make a given whole.

entries.title: How much more money is needed?
entries.objective: Count the pictured coins and find how many more cents are needed to pay the price.

entries.title: Share the pencils
entries.objective: Count two pictured sets and find how many pencils to pass so both children have an equal share.

entries.title: Trace the outline
entries.objective: Match an object to a plane shape or name the shape of a shaded face.

entries.title: Compare poles and ribbons
entries.objective: Compare the spaces between the ends of each object to order objects or find one between two others.

entries.title: Positions and sizes of groups
entries.objective: Count from a marked end to connect each card’s position with its number of dots.

entries.title: Compare calculation cards
entries.objective: Work out each card, then choose the smallest or greatest result or write the results in order.

entries.title: Count the money in the picture
entries.objective: Read the value on each coin or note to match a coin, find a payment or add savings from two days.

entries.title: Who goes where?
entries.objective: Use position clues to arrange a row and find a named member’s place.

entries.title: Taking objects away
entries.objective: Find the starting count after two groups were taken away, or choose the calculation shown by crossed-out objects.

entries.title: One addend for each group
entries.objective: Read equal groups, write one addend for each group and find the total.

entries.title: How were the shapes sorted?
entries.objective: Compare sets of shapes and identify the features used to sort them.

entries.title: Find the larger amount
entries.objective: Use a known count and how many more to find the larger count.

entries.title: Subtract by place value
entries.objective: Subtract ones and tens, trading a ten when needed. Find the difference or its tens digit.

entries.title: Find what to take away
entries.objective: Find the number to take away so that both sides give the same answer.

entries.title: What do the two items cost?
entries.objective: Find the prices of two named items and write a number sentence for their total in cents or dollars.

entries.title: Fill both number gaps
entries.objective: Place two given numbers in the gaps to make a comparison sentence true.

entries.title: How are the pencils grouped?
entries.objective: Tell how many groups there are and how many objects are in each group.

entries.title: Read tens and ones
entries.objective: Read a two-digit number or a collection and identify its tens and ones.

entries.title: Compare sticks and strips
entries.objective: Use a shared starting line to find which object is shorter or taller than a named object.

entries.title: Make another ten
entries.objective: Exchange ten ones for one ten and write the number the tens and ones make.

entries.title: Choose numbers for a total
entries.objective: Choose three cards for a given total or match each number with its partner for that total.

entries.title: Make a share for everyone
entries.objective: Count the gifts or the people, then use every item to make equal shares within 20.

entries.title: Count in ones
entries.objective: Find the number just before a given number or the only whole number between two bounds.

entries.title: Make the groups
entries.objective: Use every pictured object once to make a given number of groups of a given size.

entries.title: Write an equal-group equation
entries.objective: Use the number of groups and the number in each group to write a multiplication equation within 40.

entries.title: Make groups of the same size
entries.objective: Use every object once to make groups of a given size and count the groups.

entries.title: Find the matching cards
entries.objective: Compare the values on number cards to find matches or the one that differs.

entries.title: Which shapes belong together?
entries.objective: Compare the sides and corners of shapes, even when the shapes are turned or have different sizes.

entries.title: Write a sum as tens and ones
entries.objective: Add within 100 with regrouping, then report the tens and ones of the sum.

entries.title: Find two numbers a given distance apart
entries.objective: Select two numbers whose difference matches a given number.

entries.title: Share two amounts equally
entries.objective: Add two amounts, then share their total equally.

entries.title: Choose three buckets
entries.objective: Choose three different full buckets whose volumes add up to the required number of litres.

entries.title: Shopping by the pack
entries.objective: Use two pack prices to find the total spent or the money left.

entries.title: Tell the time of day
entries.objective: Read both clock hands and use a morning or afternoon clue to write the time with am or pm.

entries.title: Put fractions in order
entries.objective: Order three unit fractions and find the smallest or greatest of four fractions with the same denominator.

entries.title: Find the missing fraction
entries.objective: Find the share that completes one whole when one or two portions are known.

entries.title: Find the number that makes both sides equal
entries.objective: Work out a sum, a product or a number given in tens and ones, then find the missing number in the equation.

entries.title: Count semicircles and quarters
entries.objective: Spot semicircles in a joined design and count the quarter-circle pieces that fill several shapes.

entries.title: Count the tens
entries.objective: Express a whole total in tens, finding the product first when two factors are shown.

entries.title: Compare sets of coins and notes
entries.objective: Count each set in the same unit to match a price or find the most or least money.

entries.title: Match a number to its parts
entries.objective: Use hundreds, tens and ones to match a sum to a number or find a missing part.

entries.title: What time does the meal finish?
entries.objective: Count on in minutes from a whole hour and use the event to choose am or pm.

entries.title: Choose coins to pay exactly
entries.objective: Choose coins from a tray to make a price, using any coin or count rules given.

entries.title: Build a number from digit cards
entries.objective: Choose three different cards and compare arrangements with an odd or even last digit to find the smallest or largest number.

entries.title: Find a fraction from pieces
entries.objective: Use counts of equal pieces to write the fraction of one whole used, given away or left.

entries.title: Count the labels in a picture graph
entries.objective: Count each label once, either across the whole graph or for rows above a given amount.

entries.title: Solve two number clues
entries.objective: Use one clue to find a total or an earlier count, then use it to find the missing number.

entries.title: Find the number from its digits
entries.objective: Use place value and arithmetic clues to find a single two- or three-digit number.

entries.title: Build a number from its place counts
entries.objective: Use hundreds, tens and ones to choose a numeral, exchanging groups of ten when needed.

entries.title: Label a removal model
entries.objective: Use a part-whole model to find and label an amount removed.

entries.title: Fill both number sentences
entries.objective: Use the number of pictured groups as a factor and as the divisor in a related division fact.

entries.title: Share beads from one collection
entries.objective: Read two named rows of a picture graph and find how many beads to move to make the collections equal.

entries.title: Compare three prices
entries.objective: Compare dollars first and cents next to choose an item or put three prices in order.

entries.title: Compare two amounts
entries.objective: Use the smaller amount and the extra part to explain the larger amount.

entries.title: What can Mira buy?
entries.objective: Count the money or read the budget, then choose one item or two different items that meet the spending rule.

entries.title: Match a category to a reference
entries.objective: Read a picture graph key, double, halve or add a stated amount to a reference count, then name the matching category.

entries.title: Compare amounts in a table or picture graph
entries.objective: Read the rows needed for each amount, then find the difference.

entries.title: Match lengths from end to end
entries.objective: Compare two spans, match a line to a reference, and use a shared diagram to identify equal lengths and find a difference.

entries.title: Find the mass of part of a load
entries.objective: Read or use a total mass, take away the known masses, and count equal containers when needed.

entries.title: Count the pieces in a paper train
entries.objective: Sort the pieces of one picture by shape, record their counts and compare two counts.

entries.title: Draw a longer or shorter line
entries.objective: Use a known length and a difference to draw a horizontal segment of the required length.

entries.title: Count the wheels on the toy shelf
entries.objective: Find the wheels on one kind of toy, then use its wheels per toy when asked for a toy count.

entries.title: Count fraction pieces
entries.objective: Use the name of a unit fraction to count its pieces in one whole and in several equal-sized wholes.

entries.title: Count the shares first
entries.objective: Find how many people or days share a total, then divide to find the amount for one.

entries.title: Compare distances, heights and masses
entries.objective: Use a diagram to find the measurements you need, then compare them in the same unit.

entries.title: Find the digit or its place
entries.objective: Read a digit in a named place, or name the place of a given digit.

entries.title: Find the number that fits the clues
entries.objective: Use times tables to find the only total that fits the grouping clues and the given limits.

entries.title: Read and write money amounts
entries.objective: Write a price in figures and identify its whole dollars and remaining cents.

entries.title: How far apart are the flags?
entries.objective: Count the gaps between two numbered flags and use the length of one gap to find the distance.

entries.title: Weigh the other load
entries.objective: Use the mass of equal items and a second weighing or comparison to find one missing mass.

entries.title: Weigh a group of rice sacks
entries.objective: Use a level balance to find the mass of one sack, then find the mass of several equal sacks.

entries.title: Measure with equal units
entries.objective: Use equal lengths or equal masses to find a total or the number of units that fit.

entries.title: Build the smallest or greatest number
entries.objective: Choose digit cards for the hundreds, tens and ones places to make the smallest or greatest possible three-digit number.

entries.title: Choose the greatest or smallest value
entries.objective: Read each choice as a whole number and select the greatest or smallest value.

entries.title: Trace straight and curved lines
entries.objective: Trace outlines and letter strokes to decide which ones fit a line rule.

entries.title: How many minutes passed?
entries.objective: Find a duration in minutes by reading two clocks or following the minute hand clockwise.

entries.title: Count pieces from a fraction
entries.objective: Use a fraction of a whole to count equal pieces, then find how many were used or what fraction is left.

entries.title: Find the parts that make a fraction
entries.objective: Choose three like fractions that make a given total, or use a known total to find a missing part and the part left over.

entries.title: Count containers for everyone
entries.objective: Use full groups and leftovers to find the smallest number of equal-capacity containers or trips that fits everyone.

entries.title: How many more are needed?
entries.objective: Multiply equal daily groups over a range of days, then find how many more are needed to reach a target.

entries.title: How tall is the post?
entries.objective: Use a level line and equal blocks to find a height in centimetres.

entries.title: Find the hidden subtraction digit
entries.objective: Use the ones column to recover a hidden digit and check it in the completed subtraction.

entries.title: Find the value of one circle
entries.objective: Find the value of a symbol in a picture graph from a total or a difference.

entries.title: Read lengths on a ruler
entries.objective: Use both end marks to measure a piece, identify the longest piece or find the total length of equal pieces.

entries.title: Use clues to compare lengths and masses
entries.objective: Link comparisons to find the longest ribbon or to identify both the lightest and heaviest parcels.

entries.title: Find the mass of one toy
entries.objective: Use equal pan loads or a combined scale reading to find a missing mass in grams.

entries.title: Compare bags on weighing scales
entries.objective: Read gram dials, choose the lightest and heaviest bags, and find their total mass or the difference between their masses.

entries.title: Find the named solid
entries.objective: Choose, from several pictured solids, the one that matches a given solid name.

entries.title: How much longer or heavier?
entries.objective: Use a stated difference to find another length or mass. When there are two comparisons, identify the starting measurement for each.

entries.title: Find the missing number of notes or coins
entries.objective: Find how much money is left, then use the value of one note or coin to count how many fit.

entries.title: Missing numbers in related sums
entries.objective: Use equal totals, repeated shapes or place-value columns to find one missing number.

entries.title: Find a missing amount or a total
entries.objective: Work in cents to find a missing part or a two-day total, then write the answer in the unit requested.

entries.title: Compare two collections
entries.objective: Use the smaller collection as one equal part to find a total, a difference or the value of one part.

entries.title: Put numbers in order
entries.objective: Compare whole numbers by place value to arrange a list, check a row or complete a strict inequality.

entries.title: Choose and count odd numbers
entries.objective: Use the ones digit to find odd numbers, then check their size, compare them or count them within a range.

entries.title: Find the missing third part
entries.objective: Use a total and two known parts to find the part that is missing.

entries.title: Find the change or the starting amount
entries.objective: Use the prices and the money left to find how much was paid, returned or held at first.

entries.title: Count the money at the till
entries.objective: Count notes or coins and use the price to find the change or the amount handed over.

entries.title: Find the money still needed
entries.objective: Compare the full price with the money saved to find a missing amount or choose a payment that falls short.

entries.title: Read or match a pictured fraction
entries.objective: Use equal parts to name a fraction or find the pictures that show it.

entries.title: Sides and corners of a flat shape
entries.objective: Name a flat shape from clues about its sides, or trace its outline to count its corners.

entries.title: Fill in the missing unit
entries.objective: Use a familiar mass or length to choose the unit that fits a given number.

entries.title: Money before and after shopping
entries.objective: Find the cost of the items bought, then use it to find starting money, money left or change.

entries.title: How many are in the queue?
entries.objective: Use a child’s place in a queue to count everyone once, including anyone who joins later.

entries.title: Read or finish a picture graph
entries.objective: Use the key to read one row or build its circles from a count, including a count found from the total.

entries.title: Find the missing badges
entries.objective: Read a picture graph, subtract the known part from the whole and use the key to complete a missing row.

entries.title: Regroup a fixed total
entries.objective: Multiply equal groups to find the total, then divide by a new group size to find how many new groups can be made.

entries.title: One addend for each group
entries.objective: Match equal groups, repeated addition and multiplication using the number of groups and the size of each group.

entries.title: Find when the first task began
entries.objective: Add equal task durations and count backwards from a finish time after noon.

entries.title: Follow a path
entries.objective: Trace the parts of a path to find a distance in metres or compare the lengths of strings.

entries.title: Build circles from semicircles
entries.objective: Recognise that two semicircles form one circle and count the pieces needed for several circles.

entries.title: Count the solids in a model
entries.objective: Identify the pieces in a model, count each kind and compare two counts.

entries.title: Look at the surfaces
entries.objective: Select pictured objects by how they roll or by the flat and curved surfaces they have.

entries.title: Follow two activities on the clock
entries.objective: Find when one activity ends and use that time to find when the next activity ends.

entries.title: Use the smallest and largest numbers
entries.objective: Select the smallest and largest of four numbers and find their sum or difference.

entries.title: Find the total when everyone or every day counts
entries.objective: Work out how many people or days to count, then multiply by the amount for each one.

entries.title: Find the other amount and the total
entries.objective: Use the smaller amount and the difference to find the larger amount, then add both amounts and give the total in dollars.

entries.title: Find the two amounts
entries.objective: Use a difference to find a larger count, or use a sum and a difference to find two missing digits.

entries.title: Two changes to a collection
entries.objective: Follow two changes to find a final count, or undo them to find the starting count.

entries.title: How many cards are blue?
entries.objective: Use the card count and the dot total to find how many cards carry fewer dots.

entries.title: Find the price of the other item
entries.objective: Use the price of one item to find the cost of several, then subtract their cost from the bill. Use the same money unit throughout.

entries.title: Find the hidden digits
entries.objective: Use place value and regrouping to recover digits in three-digit addition and subtraction.

entries.title: Put measurements in order
entries.objective: Compare whole masses, bent lengths and equal pours to find an order or a requested place.

entries.title: Compare lengths and masses
entries.objective: Compare lengths in metres and centimetres, or read weighing scales in kilograms and grams to order three items.

entries.title: Count what was there and what is left
entries.objective: Use equal groups to find how many items were there at first or how many are left.

entries.title: Follow two changes in a measurement
entries.objective: Use the middle measurement to find a final length or the mass that was added.

entries.title: Compare three amounts of money
entries.objective: Use price or savings clues to find a difference and, when asked, the total of three amounts.

entries.title: Tickets for a puppet show
entries.objective: Match tickets to their prices and find the cost for one group or the whole family.

entries.title: Count what is in both boxes
entries.objective: Use the smaller count and the difference to find the larger count, then add both counts.

entries.title: Read a number in words
entries.objective: Write or choose the three-digit numeral for a number given in words.

entries.title: Find the larger amount
entries.objective: Use a stated difference to find a larger amount, then combine the counts or follow a second comparison when asked.

entries.title: Find the matching bar
entries.objective: Read a named bar, multiply or divide its count, and find the design with that many bookmarks.

entries.title: Find two bars with a target total
entries.objective: Read a bar graph and choose two different bars whose values add to a named bar or to a stated total.

entries.title: Count the blue and yellow bags
entries.objective: Use the total number of bags and buttons to find how many bags are of each colour.

entries.title: How much are the coins and notes worth?
entries.objective: Use counts and denominations to compare piles of coins, choose an affordable item or find a new balance.

entries.title: Compare counts on a bar graph
entries.objective: Find a gap between counts by reading a scale, combining groups or checking a claim.

entries.title: Find the part missing from a chart
entries.objective: Read the known groups, use the graph key when needed, and subtract their sum from the whole.

entries.title: Choose items within a budget
entries.objective: Add the prices of two or three different items and compare the total with a budget. For least change, find the largest total the shopper can pay.

entries.title: What time will the clock show?
entries.objective: Use the minutes a clock is ahead or behind to find a later reading or the correct time.

entries.title: Minutes past and minutes to
entries.objective: Read both clock hands and tell the time in minutes past the hour or minutes to the next hour.

entries.title: Swap money for coins
entries.objective: Find the amount to be returned in coins and work out how many coins have that value.

entries.title: Count complete tens or hundreds
entries.objective: Count all the full groups of ten or one hundred in a number, including a number found by adding or dividing.

entries.title: When does puppet practice finish?
entries.objective: Count on through each activity and any break to find the finish time.

entries.title: Cut pieces and fill containers
entries.objective: Count whole pieces or full containers, then find the length left, the number still there or the difference between two counts.

entries.title: Count the coins, then find the missing amount
entries.objective: Decide whether the coins show money held or money paid, then find a price or a balance.

entries.title: Share beads at craft club
entries.objective: Count everyone who shares the beads, then find how many beads each child gets.

entries.title: Money left after a purchase
entries.objective: Find a missing price or share before working out change, or use the money left to work out another amount.

entries.title: Make the largest and smallest numbers
entries.objective: Use place value and the ones digit to build an extreme number, then compare by subtraction when asked.

entries.title: Find what a digit is worth
entries.objective: Locate a digit in a four-digit number, compare its value across numbers and find its value after addition.

entries.title: Distance around a field
entries.objective: Find the distance around a rectangle and use it to work out the total distance for several full laps.

entries.title: Compare the time three children took
entries.objective: Use two time differences to find the longest duration and how much longer it is than the shortest.

entries.title: Count the edges around a shape
entries.objective: Count equal lengths around a shape and use the length of one to find its perimeter.

entries.title: Area covered by square tiles
entries.objective: Use the size and number of equal squares to find the area they cover.

entries.title: Find the fraction that fits
entries.objective: Use equivalent forms to spot a different value or find a fraction equal to two given fractions.

entries.title: Multiply the even numbers
entries.objective: Use the ones digits to find the even numbers in a list, then multiply them together.

entries.title: Build a four-digit number
entries.objective: Compare possible last digits to build the smallest or greatest number that meets a rule.

entries.title: Compare two cash tins after a payment
entries.objective: Find the new difference after one tin pays out money, then use equal shares to find the amount in the other tin.

entries.title: Fill the gaps in equal fractions
entries.objective: Use a known fraction or one whole to find missing top and bottom numbers.

entries.title: Find the most or the least
entries.objective: Name the category with the most or least, using the scale, a total or a clue about a missing label.

entries.title: Find the cost of the beads
entries.objective: Read a quantity from a scaled graph and use a price in cents to find the cost in dollars.

entries.title: Pack the beads that are left
entries.objective: Subtract the beads set aside, then find the number of packs, the beads left over or the number in each pack.

entries.title: Which numbers fit between the limits?
entries.objective: Use the two limits to list the odd numbers or times-table answers that fit. Count them, add them or find the numbers that made them.

entries.title: Around two joined squares
entries.objective: Find the distance around two joined squares, leaving out the edge they share.

entries.title: Find the children from their bars
entries.objective: Name the two children with equal counts, then find a child from a difference in counts.

entries.title: Find the whole hours and minutes left over
entries.objective: Group a duration into whole hours and keep track of the minutes left over.

entries.title: Trace a stepped perimeter
entries.objective: Use matching lengths to find the distance around the requested outline.

entries.title: Which digits fit the boxes?
entries.objective: Use place value, exchanges and carries to find a digit in a written calculation.

entries.title: Find the missing amount
entries.objective: Use the same unit for all amounts, find a missing part, and compare the parts when asked.

entries.title: Find money from a difference and a multiple
entries.objective: Use the number of extra equal parts to share a money difference, then rebuild a starting amount or a combined total.

entries.title: Find the cost of both items
entries.objective: Use a price difference to find the dearer item’s price, then add both prices.

entries.title: Compare two jars of beads
entries.objective: Use a comparison before or after beads are added to find a jar’s count, then combine the counts when asked.

entries.title: Count in tens, hundreds and thousands
entries.objective: Use place-value units to find a new number or count the jumps between two numbers.

entries.title: Reading and writing four-digit numbers
entries.objective: Write a named number in digits, or compare four numbers and write the greatest in words.

entries.title: Find the number from its digit clues
entries.objective: Use clues about digits in different places to find a missing digit or a whole number.

entries.title: Compare four numbers
entries.objective: Use place value to order four numbers from largest to smallest or to find the sum or difference of the two extremes.

entries.title: Build and split four-digit numbers
entries.objective: Use thousands, hundreds, tens and ones to build a number or find a part of its expansion.

entries.title: Take away hundreds, tens and ones
entries.objective: Work out how much to take away when it is given in place-value units, then subtract it from a number or a product.

entries.title: How far apart are the values?
entries.objective: Read two amounts from their place values and subtract the smaller amount from the larger.

entries.title: How much more money is needed?
entries.objective: Find the total cost or the money a shopper has, then work out how much more the shopper needs.

entries.title: A count and its multiple
entries.objective: Use equal groups to find a total, a smaller count or an increase, and tell when a count cannot be found.

entries.title: Money before and after shopping

entries.objective: Use the amount spent and the amount left to work out how much money someone started with, spent or kept.

entries.title: Which fold matches the spots?
entries.objective: Test a marked line by folding the whole figure, including the marks inside it.

entries.title: Who reached the target?
entries.objective: Read a frequency table or bar graph and use a cutoff to find a number or fraction of pupils.

entries.title: Follow an edge across a fold
entries.objective: Trace an edge to its folded position and use the two equal angles at the crease to reason about a right-angled corner.

entries.title: Find the starting number
entries.objective: Work out how many equal parts a count represents and use those parts to find the starting number.

entries.title: Shopping in whole packs
entries.objective: Use pack sizes and prices to find how many items a budget buys or the least cost of buying enough items.

entries.title: Count the pieces in a whole
entries.objective: Count equal fractional pieces in a length, or group fractional pieces into wholes and write what is left.

entries.title: Shade enough parts
entries.objective: Find how many extra equal parts to shade from a shaded or unshaded target fraction.

entries.title: Pack and share what is left
entries.objective: Use equal groups to find a remaining share or work backwards to a starting number.

entries.title: Share one starting amount
entries.objective: Combine percentages of one whole to find a remaining quantity, compare shares or express a combined share as a simplified fraction.

entries.title: Compare two extra purchases
entries.objective: Use a shortfall and a leftover to find a price difference, work out unit prices and recover starting money.

entries.title: Compare shopping plans
entries.objective: Use purchase quantities, money left and shortfalls to find prices and starting money.

entries.title: Areas of folded paper
entries.objective: Use equal areas before and after a fold to recover a rectangle area or find the area left after cutting.

entries.title: Find related areas
entries.objective: Use a known or calculated area and an area relationship to find a total, a component or a shaded remainder.

entries.title: Compare money after changes
entries.objective: Compare separate changes to two balances, recover starting money and find a transfer that makes the balances equal.

entries.title: Work out shopping discounts
entries.objective: Choose discounts using prices or ages, add the costs, and use combined savings to find an equal item price.

entries.title: Shop within a budget
entries.objective: Find the greatest number of items affordable when buying whole packs or individual items, including after an earlier purchase.

entries.title: Compare shares of a collection
entries.objective: Use percentages and shares of a remainder to find a total, a category percentage or an allocation shortfall.

entries.title: Working together at steady rates
entries.objective: Combine two steady rates to find a working time, recover one individual rate, or check statements about their output.

entries.title: Explore shared factors
entries.objective: Find the common factors of two whole numbers, then list, count or add them.

entries.title: Find shared multiples
entries.objective: Find the second positive common multiple or list all positive common multiples below a limit.

entries.title: Find a quantity from cost differences
entries.objective: Compare costs for equal quantities to find a common count or a combined count.

entries.title: Complete a cube arrangement
entries.objective: Count the cubes in a solid and find how many more make a stated volume, cube or cuboid.

entries.title: Find the area of joined shapes
entries.objective: Use shared sides to find missing lengths, then add square and triangle areas.

entries.title: Find shaded areas from related lengths
entries.objective: Use midpoints and side fractions to find missing lengths, then combine triangle areas.

entries.title: Find perimeter using area
entries.objective: Use area and shared sides to recover missing lengths, then find the outside perimeter.

entries.title: Work with time and constant rates
entries.objective: Use time per item, pay for part of an hour, and a water-volume graph to solve constant-rate problems.

entries.title: Find counts and amounts using equal groups
entries.objective: Use the value of a matching group to find item counts, expenditure differences or the value of coins with equal subtotals.

entries.title: Count equal fractional parts
entries.objective: Count fractional parts in an amount, a length or the gap between two mixed numbers.

entries.title: Filling and draining rectangular tanks
entries.objective: Find the volume of water to move, convert units, and use a steady flow rate to find the time needed.

entries.title: Compare and order decimals
entries.objective: Compare decimal place values to check strict bounds, order numbers, and identify the shortest duration.

entries.title: Read a decimal number line
entries.objective: Find the size of an equal interval, read a marked decimal and round when asked.

entries.title: Read and build decimals
entries.objective: Compose decimals, read their digits, name decimal places and find missing place-value components.

entries.title: Water left after pouring
entries.objective: Calculate container capacities and fractional contents, subtract the water poured, and express the remainder in the requested units.

entries.title: Find lengths from areas and arrangements
entries.objective: Use equal pieces and area relationships to recover dimensions and calculate lengths or perimeters.

entries.title: Volume from a cube edge
entries.objective: Use one edge length to find the volume of a cube.

entries.title: Share an angle using equal parts
entries.objective: Use angle facts and a multiplicative relationship to find unknown angles.

entries.title: Count points and spaces
entries.objective: Relate points to the spaces between them to find lengths, counts and new equal spacings.

entries.title: Fractions in shaded grids
entries.objective: Use equal areas to find and simplify fractions of a whole or a stated reference area.

entries.title: Find an equal daily share
entries.objective: Find a daily amount from a fraction used over several days or weeks.

entries.title: Share amounts equally
entries.objective: Combine or convert measurements, find an equal share, and round when asked.

entries.title: Find angles in overlapping shapes
entries.objective: Combine equilateral triangle angles with square corners and straight-line angles to find missing angles.

entries.title: Build and complete place-value equations
entries.objective: Compose whole numbers from place-value parts and find a missing part or group count.

entries.title: Arrange digits with odd and even rules
entries.objective: Use place value and the last digit to find extreme arrangements, and compare distances in a linked closest-number task.

entries.title: Factor lists and exact division
entries.objective: Complete factor lists and use remainders to identify nonfactors and exactly divisible numbers.

entries.title: Share the same total in new groups
entries.objective: Recover a total from equal groups, regroup it, and compare equal shares.

entries.title: Compare and order fractions
entries.objective: Use equivalent fractions to order values, find a minimum and check strict bounds.

entries.title: Change fraction representations
entries.objective: Write decimals as simplified mixed numbers and regroup whole units into fractional parts.

entries.title: Water in a partly filled tank
entries.objective: Find the volume of water using a cuboid tank’s dimensions or base area, height and filled fraction.

entries.title: Parts of a collection
entries.objective: Use fractions of one whole to compare groups, track removals and decide what can be known.

entries.title: Fractions and fixed amounts
entries.objective: Combine a fraction of a quantity with a fixed change in the correct order, or work backwards to the starting quantity.

entries.title: Check angle statements
entries.objective: Use triangle sums and vertically opposite angles to identify a statement that must be true.

entries.title: Choose a parallel line on a grid
entries.objective: Compare movements across and down a square grid to identify an undrawn parallel line.

entries.title: Charges for repeated bookings and journeys
entries.objective: Calculate one charge using an included allowance and fully charged started blocks, then find the cost of repeated bookings or journeys.

entries.title: Find a monthly instalment
entries.objective: Subtract a deposit and convert years to months to find an equal monthly payment.

entries.title: Track counters passed between groups
entries.objective: Use an unchanged total to undo transfers, equalise three groups and compare their final amounts.

entries.title: Find a missing angle at a crossing
entries.objective: Use straight-line and vertically opposite angle facts to find a missing part of an angle.

entries.title: Find a triangle height from an equal area
entries.objective: Use a rectangle area and an equal-area condition to recover a triangle perpendicular height.

entries.title: Find numbers from rounding clues
entries.objective: Use rounding limits to select a possible whole number or find an endpoint that satisfies every clue.

entries.title: Percentages of measurements
entries.objective: Compare a measured part with the whole in matching units and express the fraction as a percentage.

entries.title: Find the measurement left
entries.objective: Use common units to subtract known amounts, combine equal deductions and round a final measurement when requested.

entries.title: Order measurements
entries.objective: Convert measurements to a common unit, then order them or find the smallest.

entries.title: Find prices in a mixed purchase
entries.objective: Use a total cost and a difference between unit prices to find an item price or a category total.

entries.title: Find the nearest number
entries.objective: Compare fractional distances from a whole-number target and choose the nearest value.

entries.title: Fractions of what is left
entries.objective: Find quantities after successive fractional changes and use a later addition to recover a starting quantity.

entries.title: Order four whole numbers
entries.objective: Compare whole numbers by place value and arrange them in either direction.

entries.title: Water that spills out
entries.objective: Use the water present, water added and water lost to find overflow or capacity.

entries.title: Find prices from overlapping sets
entries.objective: Remove known sets of items to find an individual price and a related cost.

entries.title: Find equal quantities from a total value
entries.objective: Use the value of an equal pair or equal-sized group to find how many of each item there are.

entries.title: Follow angles through parallel sides
entries.objective: Use parallel sides, equal base angles and angle sums to find angles in connected shapes.

entries.title: Percentages of a collection
entries.objective: Find a group as a percentage of the whole using counts of objects.

entries.title: Work with percentage quantities
entries.objective: Find a percentage or its complement, share a percentage quantity equally, and update counts and percentages after adding one type of item.

entries.title: Decimals, fractions and percentages
entries.objective: Convert between decimals, percentages and fractions, including a fraction remaining.

entries.title: Pack portions and find what remains
entries.objective: Convert measurements to common units, account for earlier use, and find an exact portion count or the amount left after filling complete portions.

entries.title: Find a total from an amount per item
entries.objective: Derive the relevant count or related amount per item, then calculate the total quantity.

entries.title: Prices for packs and measured amounts
entries.objective: Find priced quantities from equal packs, measured amounts or related areas, then calculate the cost.

entries.title: Compare quantities using fractions
entries.objective: Use equal units to find a group size, a price or a group difference from fractional relationships.

entries.title: Find areas using related lengths
entries.objective: Use a known triangle area or related lengths to find missing dimensions and subtract shaded components.

entries.title: Read and compare digit positions
entries.objective: Name digit positions, select numbers matching place clues, and compare digit values.

entries.title: Reconstruct a money balance
entries.objective: Recover a money amount from equal payments, change, or an addition followed by spending.

entries.title: Open out a folded strip
entries.objective: Use equal lengths and midpoint relationships in folded strips to recover their original dimensions and areas.

entries.title: Find the area of a rectangular border
entries.objective: Find the outside dimensions of a rectangular border and subtract the inner area, using whole numbers or fractions.

entries.title: Find angles using a rectangle
entries.objective: Combine rectangle corners, straight lines and triangle angle sums to find a marked angle.

entries.title: Check lines of symmetry
entries.objective: Compare reflected halves to select or count figures with a required number of lines of symmetry.

entries.title: Find masses from two weighings
entries.objective: Compare loaded masses and related contents to find an empty container mass or a contents mass.

entries.title: Totals from equal amounts
entries.objective: Multiply equal measurements, account for a removed amount, and convert or round the total.

entries.title: Work back through shopping expenses
entries.objective: Recover starting money by undoing fractional purchases and fixed extra payments in reverse order.

entries.title: Work back through spending and collections
entries.objective: Recover earlier amounts from nested fractions, then find total spending or linked category counts.

entries.title: Find angles in rhombuses
entries.objective: Use rhombus properties, straight lines and equal-side triangles to find missing angles.

entries.title: Fractions as rounded decimals
entries.objective: Convert a fraction or mixed number by division, then round to the requested decimal place.

entries.title: Find shaded and unshaded areas
entries.objective: Use component areas and triangle areas to find the area of selected regions.

entries.title: Shaded areas in square arrangements
entries.objective: Use square sides and midpoint relationships to find and combine triangle areas.

entries.title: Compare areas using a shared height
entries.objective: Use equal base parts and a common perpendicular height to compare triangle areas and shaded shares.

entries.title: Work out a shopping discount
entries.objective: Find a combined usual cost, then calculate the discount and amount paid.

entries.title: Find spending and money left
entries.objective: Use equal units and fractions to connect starting money, spending and money left, then find amounts or purchase counts.

entries.title: Find angles using straight lines and full turns
entries.objective: Combine adjacent angles using right angles, straight lines and full turns.

entries.title: Follow two percentage changes
entries.objective: Use the correct amount for each percentage to find a final balance, a starting amount or a second payment.

entries.title: Find the missing angle in a full turn
entries.objective: Use two known angles to find the third angle around a point, including a reflex angle.

entries.title: Find a triangle area from related lengths
entries.objective: Find the base from its relationship to the perpendicular height, then calculate the triangle area.

entries.title: Triangle areas inside squares and rectangles
entries.objective: Use shared bases, heights and equal subdivisions to find triangle regions from a known enclosing area.

entries.title: Find triangle area from equal length units
entries.objective: Use a perimeter and side proportions to find two perpendicular lengths, then calculate triangle area.

entries.title: Work out prices from two purchases
entries.objective: Use two purchase totals to find unit prices, a new total cost or an affordable quantity.

entries.title: Convert metric measurements
entries.objective: Convert between compound and single metric units, using decimals or whole units and a remainder.

entries.title: Volume from related dimensions
entries.objective: Find a dimension from a fraction of another dimension, then calculate the volume of a cuboid or its water.

entries.title: Find a whole or another part
entries.objective: Use a known fractional amount to find the whole and, when needed, another part.

entries.title: Find a whole from its final share
entries.objective: Use fractions of a starting quantity and a fixed change to find the whole and the requested total.

entries.title: Find a whole from a difference
entries.objective: Compare fractions of the same whole and use a known difference to find the starting quantity.

entries.title: Combine amounts written with letters
entries.objective: Combine component expressions, account for repeated quantities, and evaluate a requested total or subtotal.

entries.title: Share what is left equally
entries.objective: Form or evaluate an expression by subtracting deductions from a starting amount and dividing the remainder into equal shares.

entries.title: Angles where lines cross
entries.objective: Use straight-line and vertically opposite angle facts to calculate angles and check statements.

entries.title: Find percentage increases and discounts
entries.objective: Recover starting quantities and prices, then calculate percentage increases or discounts.

entries.title: Water volume from tank measurements
entries.objective: Find the water volume in a rectangular tank and convert cubic centimetres to litres.

entries.title: Angles split by a rhombus diagonal
entries.objective: Use equal angles beside a rhombus diagonal, then follow straight lines and parallel sides to find missing angles.

entries.title: Compare triangle areas using bases, heights and ratios
entries.objective: Compare triangles with base-times-height products or shared heights, then use the ratio to find a simplest-form ratio, a total area or an unshaded area.

entries.title: Combine totals and averages
entries.objective: Find category totals using their sizes, then combine the totals and find an overall average when needed.

entries.title: Whole shares and the remainder
entries.objective: Find category shares from fractions or percentages, split a remainder, and use the shares to form a ratio or recover a total.

entries.title: Choose packs and offers
entries.objective: Compare whole packs and individual purchases to find the least cost or greatest quantity.

entries.title: Painted faces and hidden cubes
entries.objective: Use layers and outside faces to count small cubes in rectangular blocks, including totals across separate blocks.

entries.title: Compare quantities using percentages
entries.objective: Choose the reference quantity, use matching units or a row total when needed, and calculate a percentage.

entries.title: Which nets make the prism?
entries.objective: Check matching edges and opposite ends to recognise nets of a triangular prism.

entries.title: Measure a drawn angle
entries.objective: Place a protractor at the vertex, align its zero with one arm and measure an obtuse angle.

entries.title: Compare purses and prices
entries.objective: Count the dollars in each purse or read each price tag, then find the most or the least.

entries.title: Compare a group with the whole
entries.objective: Use ratio parts to express a group compared with the whole collection.

entries.title: Totals of related quantities
entries.objective: Express related quantities using a letter, then combine them to find a total.

entries.title: Complete a shaded pattern
entries.objective: Pair squares across a mirror line and find the fewest squares needed to complete the pattern.

entries.title: Collect letter terms and numbers
entries.objective: Combine like terms and constants in linear expressions without brackets.

entries.title: Find the perimeter of a square and triangle
entries.objective: Use equal sides and shared edges to find a composite perimeter.

entries.title: Find a sum of angles in two squares
entries.objective: Use square corners and a given angle to find and add two unknown angles.

entries.title: Work out related quantities
entries.objective: Use fractional comparisons and equal ratio parts to find a combined amount, one share or a category fraction.

entries.title: Two purchases with different prices
entries.objective: Use fractions of a budget and relative prices to find a total item count or spending on one type of item.

entries.title: Follow angles into a triangle
entries.objective: Use parallel sides and straight lines to find angles, then complete a triangle.

entries.title: Follow exterior angles in a triangle
entries.objective: Use an exterior angle and the angles of a triangle to find another exterior angle.

entries.title: Find an amount using ratio groups
entries.objective: Weight ratio parts by counts or prices, then use a total to find an individual amount or category count.

entries.title: Find the wire left after a construction
entries.objective: Find a rectilinear construction perimeter from component lengths and subtract it from a wire length.

entries.title: Rectangle arrangements and matching spans
entries.objective: Use matching lengths in two arrangements of identical rectangles to find a width, length, gap or height.

entries.title: Find a card’s length and area
entries.objective: Use the distance around a rectangle and its breadth to find its length, then use both sides to find its area.

entries.title: Find the area of a path and the perimeter of a lawn
entries.objective: Use the width of a path on all four sides to find the area it covers and the distance around the lawn inside it.

entries.title: Equations for the same number bond
entries.objective: Use the same whole and two parts to write related equations or check a given equation.

entries.title: Work backwards through fraction and fixed removals
entries.objective: Undo fractional and fixed removals in reverse order to find an original amount or the first share.

entries.title: Angles in a rhombus and an equilateral triangle
entries.objective: Use rhombus side and angle properties with an equilateral triangle to find an unknown angle.

entries.title: Count the stickers before and after a gift
entries.objective: Use equal counts or a known difference to find how many stickers the children had before or after a gift.

entries.title: Find volume from square information
entries.objective: Recover a square side from its area or perimeter, then use it to find volume.
